scope: A finite logical-independence test. It grants a common-ground map for every trace-preserving lift but does not silently add an equivalence relation. It proves nothing about physics, public objectivity, or external time.
premise_granted: For each of 16 lifts ell, Ground(ell)=G.

restricted_conclusion: One ground can ground many genuine aspect-contents, so common grounding does not derive full Q-coordinate gauge. Full gauge becomes available only after GAQ_trace is explicitly adopted; that adoption denies that cross-sector Q relations add content beyond trace. It can be used as a labelled minimal fibre-local branch, but not reported as a consequence of ground unity alone.
